parts.geometry: cabinet frame with four legs and openings for doors/drawers

active_constraints.directional: The main frame rests stationary on the ground surface, supporting all other components.
active_constraints.contact_friction: The legs make frictional contact with the stone patio surface to prevent sliding.
active_constraints.material: Solid teak or hardwood construction provides structural rigidity for all mounted parts.
active_constraints.safety: The frame must remain stable and not tip when drawers or doors are opened.

invalid_behaviors: ROTATIONAL — the frame is a static structure with no pivot
DEFORMATION — rigid hardwood frame does not deform under normal use
ROLLING — no wheels or rolling elements on the base

parts.geometry: box with beveled edges and slatted top surface

active_constraints.contact_friction: The slatted wood top provides a friction surface for placing items like bottles and trays.
active_constraints.material: Hardwood planks are finished to resist outdoor weather and moisture.
active_constraints.safety: Items placed on the surface must not slide off easily due to adequate friction.

invalid_behaviors: ROTATIONAL — the top is fixed to the frame
LINEAR_TRANSLATIONAL — the top does not slide or translate
DEFORMATION — rigid wood surface does not deform under normal loads

parts.geometry: 5-sided open back box with a shaker style front panel

active_constraints.directional: The left drawer translates linearly outward along the depth axis of the cabinet.
active_constraints.range_limits: The drawer has a maximum extension limit defined by internal drawer slides or stop mechanisms.
active_constraints.clearance: The drawer must clear the frame opening without binding or rubbing against adjacent drawers.
active_constraints.internal_volume: The drawer interior provides storage volume for items.
active_constraints.kinematic_chain: The drawer handle initiates the pulling force which translates to the full drawer body.

invalid_behaviors: ROTATIONAL — drawers translate linearly, they do not rotate
DEFORMATION — rigid wood drawer box does not deform
TWISTING_TORQUE — no twisting motion is involved in drawer operation
